svg.title: The Tiny-Shakespeare model learning to write, as a score.
svg.desc: 6 staves, top to bottom, at training steps 0, 100, 300, 1000, 3000, 5000. Each stave has 65 lines, one per character, ordered by frequency in Tiny Shakespeare (the space, in value ink, at the top). Each strand is the first 96 characters of one sample from the model at that step, at temperatures 0.5, 0.8, 1, 1.5 (darker = colder), prompted with a newline.
